questions.label: Products or services
questions.title: What do you sell or do?
questions.help: Products, services, or both — tell me in your own words.
questions.placeholder: For example: I sell ready-to-wear clothes and do alterations.

questions.label: Your customers
questions.title: Who usually buys from you?
questions.help: Who are they, and where are they? It’s okay if you’re still figuring this out.
questions.placeholder: For example: working women in Ibadan, mostly buying on WhatsApp.

questions.label: Where you sell
questions.title: Where do customers buy from you?
questions.help: Choose all that apply. Online, offline, or both.
questions.placeholder: For example: market stall, referrals, or home visits.

questions.label: Orders in a typical month
questions.title: About how many orders do you get in a month?
questions.help: An estimate is fine. Count customer orders or bookings, not individual items.
options: It varies a lot / I’m not sure

questions.label: People in your business
questions.title: How many people work in your business?
questions.help: Include yourself, part-time staff, and anyone who regularly helps — paid or unpaid.

questions.label: Your priority
questions.title: What would you most like to improve right now?
questions.help: Pick the one that matters most today. We can work on the others later.
options: Get existing customers to buy again
questions.placeholder: What would make the biggest difference to your business?

questions.label: What’s getting in the way
questions.title: What’s making that difficult at the moment?
questions.help: No perfect answer needed. Tell me what running the business feels like right now.
questions.placeholder: For example: people ask for prices but don’t order, or delivery costs put them off.

suggestions: Help me get more customers this week.
